grandparents_cupboard.reason: Grapes, plums, oats, flour, almonds, sugar, oil and cinnamon are all plain cupboard and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a baking dish, a mixing bowl, a knife and an oven are needed, and a crumble is beginner technique.

works.reason: Fruit, topping and oil quantities suit four snack portions, and 25 to 30 minutes at 200°C will crisp the topping and soften the fruit.

honest_times.reason: Stoning four plums, chopping a handful of almonds and mixing the topping fits 12 minutes, and the 30-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Red grapes match the grapes id, every listed item including the cinnamon is used, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Grapes are the main fruit in an August fruit crumble alongside seasonal plums, so they are the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps read as plain British home-cook instructions, though 'the rest of a tsp of cinnamon' is slightly clumsy.

hearty_healthy.reason: Plenty of fruit with oats and almonds and only two tablespoons of sugar makes a wholesome snack a family would want.
